# `select.group_rename`: Rename group

Renames a named group, keeping its elements and position in the list.

- Category: select
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(groups)
- Flags: undoable
- Also known as: rename vertex group, rename face map

Use meaningful names (`lid_rim`, `handle_l`) so later ops and agents can find geometry.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from` | `string` | required | Current group name. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |
| `to` | `string` | required | New group name; must be free. |

## Examples

```json
{"from":"top","target":"crate","to":"lid_face"}
```

Result: `crate (o:1): renamed group top to lid_face`
